metadata.description: FAQ/intents for a chatbot on a notary appointment registration website.
metadata.structure: Each object contains an intent, grouped question variants, and one answer.
matching_notes: Use fallback only when no intent matches.

fallback.answer: I can help with notary appointments, document type selection, document uploads, identity verification, signature certification, certified copies, apostille, payment, and delivery. Describe what you need to do with the document, or upload it so I can help identify the right appointment type.

faqs.answer: Hi. I can help you choose the right notary appointment, understand your document type, upload your document, check identity requirements, explain apostille, or guide you through booking.

questions: what can you help me with
faqs.answer: I can help with choosing an appointment type, explaining notary services, checking what documents may be needed, guiding document upload, explaining identity verification, apostille, payment, delivery, and booking steps.

questions: what is the job of a notary
faqs.answer: A notary is a legally authorised official who helps make certain documents legally reliable. A notary can verify identity, certify signatures, certify copies, prepare or authenticate legal documents, and confirm that a person signed a document willingly and correctly.

questions: when do i need a notary
why do i need a notary
do i have to notarise this
do i have to notarize this
faqs.answer: You usually need a notary when a document must be legally verified, signed in front of an authorised person, used for official purposes, used abroad, or accepted by a court, bank, company register, authority, embassy, or another institution.

questions: what does it mean to notarise a document
what does it mean to notarize a document
faqs.answer: Notarisation means a notary formally verifies part of a legal act, such as a signature, identity, copy, declaration, or document. It gives the document stronger legal reliability.

questions: what is a deed by notary
do i need a notarial deed
faqs.answer: A notarial deed is a formal legal document prepared or recorded by a notary. It is usually needed for more serious legal transactions, depending on the law and the document type.

questions: can the notary confirm my signature
faqs.answer: Signature certification means the notary confirms that a specific person signed the document. You usually need to prove your identity and sign during the appointment or through an approved digital signing process.

questions: can you certify a copy of my passport
can you certify a copy of my diploma
can you certify a copy of my birth certificate
can you certify a copy of my marriage certificate
do i need the original for a certified copy
faqs.answer: A certified copy confirms that a copy matches the original document shown to the notary. You normally need to provide the original document, not only a scan or photo.

questions: how can i register for an appointment
faqs.answer: To book, choose the correct appointment type, upload the required document if needed, enter your personal details, complete any identity or payment steps shown on the page, and confirm the appointment.

questions: which appointment type should i choose
what appointment type do i need
i do not know which service to select
what notary service do i need
faqs.answer: Choose the appointment type based on what you need done: signature certification, certified copy, power of attorney, company document, real estate document, apostille, or another legal document. If you upload the document or describe its purpose, I can help identify the likely appointment type.
Same-day or urgent availability depends on the current appointment calendar. Check the booking page for the earliest available slot.
You should book an appointment before the notary meeting. This helps ensure the correct service, document, identity details, and time slot are prepared.
Use the reschedule option in your confirmation email or account if available. If you cannot find it, contact support before the appointment time.

questions: i do not need the appointment anymore
faqs.answer: Use the cancellation link or contact support. Cancellation rules may depend on the appointment type and how soon the appointment is scheduled.

questions: how much time does it take
how long is the notary meeting
faqs.answer: Simple signature or copy certification appointments are usually short, but timing depends on the document type, number of signers, identity checks, and whether apostille or delivery is needed.
Use the upload section on this page. After uploading, I can help identify the likely document type and guide you to the correct appointment.

questions: what type of document did i upload
is this a power of attorney
faqs.answer: Upload the document and I can help identify the likely document type, such as power of attorney, signature certification, certified copy, company document, declaration, real estate document, or apostille-related document.
The document should be complete, readable, upright, and not blurry. Include all pages, especially pages with names, signatures, dates, powers, declarations, or official stamps.
Upload the correct file again if the page allows it. If the wrong file is already attached to a submitted booking, contact support or update the booking before the appointment.

questions: can you autofill from my document
can you read the names from the document
can you fill booking details automatically
faqs.answer: If document autofill is available, the system can use the uploaded document to suggest details such as names, document type, dates, and relevant fields. Always review the filled information before submitting.

questions: what do i need for appointment
do i need proof of address
faqs.answer: You usually need a valid official photo ID and the document that needs notarisation. Depending on the case, you may also need originals, company documents, proof of authority, translations, or supporting certificates.
You need a valid official photo ID, such as a passport or national ID card. For online appointments, identity verification is also required before or during the video process.

questions: can i use expired id card
faqs.answer: Usually, you need a valid official photo ID. If your only ID is expired, contact support or the notary office before booking.

questions: my name is different on the document
faqs.answer: If your name differs between your ID and document, you may need supporting proof such as a marriage certificate, name change certificate, or corrected document. Contact support if you are unsure before the appointment.
For signature certification, do not sign too early unless instructed. The notary usually needs to witness or verify the signing process.

questions: do all signers need to attend
faqs.answer: All people whose signatures must be certified usually need to attend and verify their identity. Witness requirements depend on the document type.

Many signature certification services can be done online through video identification and digital signing. Whether your exact document can be handled online depends on the document type and the country or institution where it will be used.

questions: what do i need for online appointment
faqs.answer: For an online notary appointment, you usually need a stable internet connection, camera, microphone, valid photo ID, the document to be signed, and access to the digital signing or identity verification process shown on the platform.

Online notarisation can be legally valid when completed through the required identity verification, video process, digital signature, and notary procedure. Acceptance can still depend on the document type and where the document will be used.

questions: i need a power of attorney
faqs.answer: A power of attorney is a common notary document. Upload the document and select the appointment type related to power of attorney or signature certification. If it will be used abroad, apostille or translation may also be needed.

questions: does the person receiving power need to attend
does authorised person need to be present
does the representative need to attend
does the person i give power to need appointment
faqs.answer: Usually, the person giving the power must attend and verify identity. The person receiving the power normally does not need to attend unless the document or notary requires it.
A power of attorney can often be used abroad, but it may need apostille, translation, or embassy legalisation depending on the destination country and the receiving institution.

An apostille is an official certificate used for international recognition of public or notarised documents between countries that accept apostilles. It confirms the authority behind the signature, seal, or stamp.

questions: do i need apostille for abroad
do i need apostille for embassy
faqs.answer: You may need an apostille if the notarised document will be used abroad. It depends on the destination country and the institution requesting the document.
If apostille service is available for your document, select it during booking or ask support. Some documents can receive apostille after notarisation, especially when intended for international use.
If the destination country does not accept apostilles, embassy or consular legalisation may be required instead. Check the requirements of the receiving country or institution.
Many company documents can involve notarial certification, such as company formation, shareholder resolutions, managing director signatures, commercial register filings, or powers of attorney.
A company representative must prove identity and authority to sign. You may need a company register extract, articles of association, resolution, or power of attorney.
Real estate documents often require notarial involvement, especially contracts, land register documents, mortgages, escrow, or powers of attorney for sale or purchase.
A notary can help with wills and inheritance-related documents. Because these documents have strict legal consequences, the notary should review the exact situation.

Family-related legal documents may require notarisation or signature certification depending on their purpose. Upload the document or describe where it will be used so the correct appointment type can be selected.
A notary may be able to certify declarations or signatures on declarations. Upload the document and mention where it will be used, since requirements differ by country and institution.

Translation rules depend on the document, language, and destination authority. Some documents require a certified or sworn translator, and sometimes notarisation or apostille must happen before translation.

questions: can my document be in english
do documents need to be in german
faqs.answer: Many English documents can be handled, but the notary must understand the document or receive a suitable translation. Acceptance also depends on the receiving institution.

questions: can document be in another language
faqs.answer: Foreign-language documents may be possible, but the notary or receiving authority may require a translation. Upload the document or describe the language and destination country.
The cost depends on the appointment type, number of documents, number of signatures, apostille, delivery, and urgency. Check the price shown during booking before confirming.

questions: can i pay by bank transfer
faqs.answer: Follow the payment options shown during booking. Available payment methods depend on the platform checkout and appointment type.
You can usually request an invoice or receipt through the booking or payment process. Add correct billing details before confirming if the appointment is for a company.
After the appointment, you receive the notarised document according to the selected service. Digital documents may be available for download, and physical delivery may be available if selected.
Check your confirmation email or account for appointment and delivery status. If the status is unclear or urgent, contact support.
Check the appointment page or confirmation email for the exact office address, access details, and whether the appointment is online or in person.
Opening hours and available appointment times depend on the booking calendar. Check the available slots on the appointment page.
Uploaded legal documents contain sensitive data. Use only the official upload flow and check the privacy policy for details about storage, access, retention, deletion, and identity data processing.

A document may be legally binding depending on its content, signatures, form, and applicable law. Notarisation strengthens verification but does not automatically make every document valid for every purpose.

questions: what if signer does not understand
faqs.answer: A notary may refuse if identity is unclear, the document is incomplete, the signer does not understand it, there is pressure or fraud risk, or the requested act is not legally allowed.

questions: can you check if document is valid
can you tell me if i should sign
faqs.answer: I can help identify the document type and likely appointment category. Final legal advice or a full legal review should come from the notary or a qualified legal professional.
Contact support or the notary office if your case is complex, urgent, involves legal uncertainty, or the assistant cannot identify the correct appointment type.
You’re welcome. Continue with booking, upload your document, or ask about the next field on the page.
Goodbye. You can continue your booking from the appointment page whenever you are ready.

I can help choose the right notary service. Tell me what the document is, where it will be used, and whether you need a signature certified, a copy certified, or an apostille. If you upload the document, I can help detect the likely document type.
